free_tier.stated: 'Cloud Shell provisions 5 GB of free persistent disk storage mounted as your $HOME directory ... on a per-user basis and is available across projects.'

egress.terms: Not specified in the quotas doc; the intended use is interactive admin, and there is no public-serving path.

tooling: `gcloud cloud-shell ssh`, `cloudshell scp`, SFTP; the $HOME is a real ext4 disk you can rclone into.
chaining: 5 GB per Google account, shared across all that account's projects. High account value (it's also a free shell with gcloud auth), so it chains well for tooling, not for capacity.
limits_note: 5 GB hard; 50 h/week quota; VM terminates after 40 min idle (files outside $HOME lost); $HOME auto-deleted after 120 days of no access; web preview is auth-gated, not public.
reliability_note: Genuinely persistent and genuinely small. The 120-day deletion is real and is announced by email only.

evidence.proved: '5 GB of free persistent disk storage mounted as your $HOME'; 'default weekly Cloud Shell quota is 50 hours'; 'don't access Cloud Shell for 120 days, Cloud Shell automatically deletes your $HOME'
